claims.evidence: Operates PC/mobile GUIs—recognizes elements, understands functions, invokes tools, completes tasks.

claims.value: Qwen3-VL is a vision-language model available in Dense and MoE architectures (235B-A22B) with Instruct and Thinking editions. Key capabilities include visual agent interaction, visual coding, spatial perception, long context/video understanding, enhanced multimodal reasoning, visual recognition, and expanded OCR.
claims.evidence: Meet Qwen3-VL — the most powerful vision-language model in the Qwen series to date.
Handles books and hours-long video with full recall and second-level indexing.
